text.text_excerpt: Love this place. I used to live down the street and now I drive 20 minutes out of the way just to grab lunch here. The chicken salad sandwich is by far the best I've ever had, it's pretty unique and always tasty. I've had several other sandwiches on the menu and all of them are great, I just revert back to old reliable if I can't decide on what to get and in no way is that depressing. The market has good produce and a decent selection of alcohol too. I usually just drop in for lunch but every time I come in I end up walking out with a couple of items I didn't plan on getting. Employees are always smiling and courteous. If you're in the area and can't decide on lunch don't sleep on this pl...

Super cute market/casual dining spot. They sell tons of locally made products and have the cutest produce happy hour. They also sell a good amount of fresh fruits and veggies as well. I was lucky enough to try their fried chicken sandwich and man did it hit the spot! First it was huge! Secondly, cooked to perfection topped with a spicy pepper slaw. It was a great change from the typical mayo doused slaw we all know. In addition to the food being excellent and reasonably priced, the staff was beyond friendly and welcoming. A total gem! Can't wait to go back

Have been here a few times and always happy with their food. The fried chicken sandwich is really good-it's a crispy chicken thigh that has a deep smoke-flavor to it with a spicy pickled-pepper slaw. They have a few other really cool sandwiches on their menu as well (like the Italian with a basil aoli). It's a cute market with lots of local produce-probably not my go-to for every day grocery shopping but it's fun to browse their aisles.
